ITEM 1 | Long, thin, flat strips with crispy browned edges and darker reddish-brown caramelized patches, slightly glossy with rendered fat, curled and layered, roughly 2 cm wide and 15 cm long, covering about 25% of the plate's upper-left area | 60
ITEM 2 | Rounded slices of reddish-brown cured meat with darker browned rims and a lighter center, firm and dense, about 2.5 cm diameter and 0.8 cm thick, three to four pieces clustered at upper right | 35
ITEM 3 | Small, dark olive-green to near-black roasted spheres with charred blistered outer surfaces and some split leaves, about 2.5 cm across, roughly eight pieces scattered in the lower-center right area | 45
ITEM 4 | Cubed pieces of pale yellow-golden fruit with bright cut faces, slightly translucent edges, and light caramelized browning on some sides, firm and moist, cubes about 2 cm per side, about ten pieces in the lower-left | 80
ITEM 5 | Cubed pieces of pale beige starchy food with golden-brown seared edges and crisp, slightly crusty surfaces, firm, cubes about 2 cm per side, about eight pieces mixed among the other items in the lower-right | 70
ITEM 6 | Small dark brown caramelized bits with slightly glossy, pitted or crumbly texture, scattered in small amounts near the cubed items | 8
